items.title: Surfaces show what they are
items.detail: Each Surface row's icon shows whether it is a document, dashboard or prototype, with a mark when it is interactive or keeps itself live. Untagged Surfaces keep the plain square.

items.title: Text keys stay text keys while you type
items.detail: In the composer's insert mode Ctrl+H, D, U, N and P edit text instead of triggering app shortcuts. Off macOS, Ctrl+M switches mode.

items.title: Move between regions with Ctrl+Alt+H/J/K/L
items.detail: Focus jumps to the nearest visible region in that direction. Press ? to see every shortcut.

items.title: The Front desk editor changes size only by whole lines
items.detail: While collapsed it no longer animates through in-between heights as you type, wrap or delete. Expanding still animates.

limits: Surface icons appear only for Surfaces whose author says what they are.
WalStudio blur and dim are verified on a test profile and test wallpaper only, not yet on your own wallpaper.
